title: Cowichan Bay Maritime Centre

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The mezzanine floor of our main museum building offers a charming and versatile space for private functions, accommodating up to 65 guests. Whether you're planning a meeting, art show, or party, our mezzanine provides a unique and scenic setting! Insurance Coverage: Included in rental fees for events without alcohol or live music. Setup and Cleanup: We encourage clients to handle their own setup and cleanup. Should you require staff assistance for these tasks, additional fees will apply. A $150 refundable damage deposit is required. Furniture: A limited number of tables and chairs are available for use at no extra

services.name: Wooden Boat Tours
services.desc: Enjoy a assortment of classic wooden boat video tours submitted by past participants of our wooden boat shows. Let the skipper take you for a virtual tour of his or her boat. Annual Wooden Boat Festival Saturday June 27th, 2026 Stay tuned for details, boat registration, dinner tickets, etc! The Cowichan Bay Maritime Centre is proudly operated by the Cowichan Wooden Boat Society. We acknowledge with gratitude that the Cowichan Bay Maritime Centre operates on the unceded, sacred, ancestral and traditional lands and waterways of the Quw’utsun peoples
